content.text:
Trump Orders Every Federal Agency to Integrate With America.gov AI Portal: The supplied timestamped feed copy reports that Trump signed an order directing agencies to integrate services with America.gov, and makes additional claims about 29,000 websites, Gemini and Grok, future service functions, 40 million daily users, and named commentary. The live page labels itself an older version and lists Sep 29 Trump War Room posts, but the direct X link could not be fetched; the additional claims are not independently verified here. (time=2026-09-29T15:14:26.128Z; cutoff=BEFORE_CUTOFF).
Streamlining Access to Government Services Through America.gov: The order text defines covered services as public-facing federal services used by more than 100,000 people in 12 months and available online, with exclusions for IRS tax filing and Department of War and intelligence services. It directs agencies to identify and integrate covered services, not to transfer all agency websites; it also preserves existing ways of obtaining services. The page is dated Sep 29, but the text's public-release time is not shown. (time=2026-09-29; cutoff=UNKNOWN).
